title: Asia's Man‑Made Marvels: Icons You Must See
summary: From the Taj Mahal to Himeji Castle, explore Asia’s greatest human‑made landmarks with nearby stays.
author: MondoExplora Editors

content_blocks.content: Pristine white marble, perfect symmetry, and serene Mughal gardens make sunrise at the Taj unforgettable.
Grand Khmer architecture intertwined with jungle. Soft dawn light over reflecting pools is pure magic.

items: Stay: Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor (Siem Reap)

content_blocks.content: Ancient engineering snakes across mountains. Golden hour paints towers and ridgelines in warm hues.

items: Stay: Commune by the Great Wall

content_blocks.content: World’s largest Buddhist monument; terraces of story‑filled reliefs and bell‑shaped stupas.
‘White Heron’ elegance meets superb preservation, manicured grounds, and panoramic top‑floor views.
